page.notes: Right margin notes are two short marginal headnotes, transcribed in place. The first is set in short lines: "De ratione re- / spondendi a- / liorum lite- / ris suasoriis, / aut dissuaso- / riis." Its wording is uncertain at the line breaks. "Ciceroniana ve-stigia": the hyphen after "ve" is faint and the word break is doubtful. The last word of the text is partly obscured at the gutter, so "instituc-" may be read differently. The running head and page number are clear. The signature is "d".
